name: aleph-zero
description: Local code search for coding agents: ranked code locations by meaning or by name, always matching the working tree, and steering that makes Claude Code use it before recursive grep

rung.title: Steering rung
rung.description: How much the plugin steers Claude Code towards Aleph. 0: the search tools only. 1: tools loaded up front with tuned descriptions, a short standing instruction, and a pointer in the descriptions of Grep and Glob. 2: also ranked locations with the first question of a session. 3: also ranked locations after a recursive grep that found nothing.

grep_pointer.title: Pointer in Grep and Glob
grep_pointer.description: Part of rung 1: whether the descriptions of Claude Code's own Grep and Glob tools point to Aleph's search. Its own switch so that it can be measured apart from the rest of the rung.

lines.title: Rung 2's lines
lines.description: What the ranked locations of rung 2 show for each file: its places, kind and name; or the same with the signature of its first result on the next line. Its own switch so that the two can be measured apart.

graph.title: Call graph, facts and decision tools
graph.description: on or off (default off). On: also offer the agent the engine's call-graph (who calls what), facts (routes, models, environment names) and decision-record tools. Off until measured to help an agent.
